{{Youmay|the starship sensor enhancer|the [[Longeye|Kaleesh criminal]]}}
A '''LongEye booster''' was a black box used to enhance the [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] would often have LongEye boosters installed on his starships, including the [[Sailfish|''Sailfish''-class transport]] ''[[Real Deal]]'' he had sold to the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] and [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] partners [[Jae Juun]] and [[Tarfang]].<ref name="DN III">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>
